summary.title: Manuals for Intel® 64 and IA-32 Architectures
summary.one_liner: Intel's official index of the x86 architecture manuals (combined, four-volume, and ten-volume sets), plus optimization guides, instruction set extension specs, and related technical papers.
takeaways: The Intel 64 and IA-32 SDM is available as one combined volume, a four-volume set, or a ten-volume set with identical content.
Volume 3B covers performance monitoring, and Volume 3 notes that performance monitoring events are listed at perfmon-events.intel.com.
Volume 4 documents the model-specific registers; Volume 2 is the full instruction set reference A-Z.
Related specs and papers cover topics such as hybrid architecture optimization, speculative execution mitigations, and the X86 encoder library XED.
summary.summary: This is Intel's download index page for the Intel 64 and IA-32 Software Developer's Manuals, the primary architecture reference for x86 processors. It describes the combined, four-volume, and ten-volume PDF sets and what each volume covers, including system programming topics such as performance monitoring, virtualization, and SGX. It also links to the Optimization Reference Manual, instruction set extension specifications (APX, AVX10), technical papers, and GitHub repositories. The page itself is a catalog of documents rather than tutorial content.
